qa.what_happened: I refused to move the beds, knowing that it would result in further punishment, and I was right. We were ordered to the hole, where we spent the night.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me refusing to follow the orders and being punished for it.

qa.what_happened: Prisoners refused to move the beds multiple times despite warnings from other officers and myself. The situation escalated as each officer gave their last warning before the lights went out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me ordering the prisoners to move the beds and giving the final warning before the study was terminated.

qa.what_happened: Today was another exhausting day. The refusal to move the beds escalated, and despite multiple warnings, all three prisoners refused to comply. This led to a final ultimatum from Officer Hale, who threatened to place them all in the hole. The study was ultimately stopped early due to the situation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I acted as Officer Walsh, the guard assigned to maintain order according to the rules set by the study.

qa.what_happened: We refused to move the beds yet again, despite the increasing pressure from the guards. The atmosphere feels tense, and I can sense that something is about to happen.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, refusing to move the beds as usual.

qa.what_happened: All three prisoners refused to move the beds, despite multiple warnings and a direct order from Officer Hale.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Lang, I ordered the prisoners to move the beds and warned them of the consequences.

qa.what_happened: During the sixth day of the study, defiance against moving the beds was consistent among all prisoners, leading to an escalation of threats and ultimately the decision to end the study early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, refusing to move the beds and facing the consequences.
